funFacts.0: Did you know? Sushi originally was a way to preserve fish in fermented rice.
funFacts.1: Thai basil and Italian basil are completely different species!
funFacts.2: Kimchi has over 200 varieties across Korea.
funFacts.3: The word 'ketchup' likely comes from the Chinese word 'ke-tsiap', a fermented fish sauce.
funFacts.4: Japanese ramen was originally a Chinese import that arrived in the 1800s.
funFacts.5: Pad Thai was invented as part of a nation-building campaign in the 1930s.
funFacts.6: The hottest chili pepper in the world changes almost every year.
funFacts.7: Fortune cookies were actually invented in San Francisco, not China.
funFacts.8: Pho is traditionally eaten for breakfast in Vietnam.
funFacts.9: MSG was first extracted from seaweed by a Japanese chemist in 1908.
